Oliver Nelson Jr. has fashioned a career in music as a flautist, saxophonist and jazz educator. He diligently oversees the music and legacy of his father, Oliver Nelson.
Oliver was interviewed via Zoom on September 10, 2020 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Oliver Nelson Jr. with me on a nice afternoon for talking music. And congratulations on your career so far.
To make a living in the arts is a challenge but also has some significant rewards I would say.
Why well it’s interesting you bring that up, because this is probably the best time of my life that didn’t make a lot of money.
